objective: qa-quinn：用户已接受UAT086，要求用此前测试OpenRouter Key/model配置本地UAT6001，并仅进行真实模型造文质量专项。不要重复全覆盖测试。只按088新授权工作，旧083已结束。你不是唯一工作者，保留他人编辑。
sample_selection_clarification: The two user-supplied five-word sets replace planned samples rather than increase request count. Normalize case only after exact frozen-vocabulary lookup and honor current group policy. Prefer a third one-word Japanese/story/short sample. No passage occurrence order or exact surface-form requirement. News content is an AI language-learning example, not factual reporting. After a successful compatibility probe, an individual content_validation_failed result does not cancel the remaining distinct planned samples: preserve it without retrying that input and continue the next distinct sample within the total cap. Stop for actual credential/balance/provider-wide availability blockers. Do not blame unseen raw meanings on the model based only on a server validation category.

execution_clarification.user_context: 此前真实生成可能需要1至2分钟，30秒测试工具等待不足。
execution_clarification.initial_enable_attempt: QA client default 30000ms timeout; not proof of model incompatibility
execution_clarification.recovery: Read-only confirm no first probe remains active. If already enabled, no repeat. If client interruption alone left disabled, one explicit recovery probe using stored encrypted credential is allowed.
execution_clarification.coverage_after_recovery: Prioritize three meaning languages and different scenes/lengths; report omitted fourth scene without extra requests.
execution_clarification.precedence: This execution clarification supersedes the one-probe/four-sample count only when the specified QA-client-timeout recovery is needed. Other acceptance boundaries remain unchanged.
execution_clarification.error_safety: Never persist or echo raw Playwright errors that include request headers; controlled categories and timeout only.
